intro: Iske baad shopping list bhoolna mushkil ho jayega.
lesson: Hamara dimaag list yaad nahi rakh paata. 6 cheezein? Shaam tak gayab.
Lekin kahani? Kahani kabhi nahi bhoolta. Agle hafte bhi yaad rahegi.
Is trick ka naam hai Story Chain. 🔗
Pehli cheez, doosri cheez ke saath kuch karti hai.
Doosri, teesri ke saath. Aise hi aage.
Jitni pagal kahani, utni pakki yaad. 😄
Chaliye, aaj ki list se try karte hain.
chat.storyIntro: Ab kahani. Har picture ko dimaag mein dekhiye. 🎬
story: Aap ek bada glass doodh pee rahe hain.
Achanak, doodh se ek bread ka slice bahar nikalta hai. Naav ki tarah tairta hua! ⛵
Bread par ek kela baitha hai. Aapko dekh kar muskura raha hai. 😄
Kela nahaa raha hai, ek gulabi sabun se. 🛁
Sabun ke bubbles ke andar chai patti udd rahi hai. 🫧
Chai patti neeche girti hai... aur 6 andon par land karti hai. Crack! 💥
Aankhein band karke ek baar aur dekhiye. Phir bataiye.
